card.name: Word before 'version' or 'edition'
card.fires_on: A modifier right before where the word 'version' or 'edition' is expected, such as a platform, language or medium (Android, Spanish, print, online, German).

modes.label: Platform or language
modes.description: A platform or language name that is about to be followed by 'version'.

modes.label: Medium or format
modes.description: A word like print, online or oral that sets up edition or version.

modes.label: Article before version
modes.description: The word 'a' just before 'version' for another platform.
modes.example: will then start work on<< a>> version for iOS

card.writes: It promotes the words version and edition (including Chinese 版 and 版本), so the model predicts them next.
card.plain: It fires on a word that describes a kind of version, like Spanish or print, just before the word 'version' or 'edition' comes.
